title: Approval Node
description: Human approval gate that pauses workflow execution until approved or rejected

fallback_decision.description: Decision to apply when the approval cannot complete for any reason and continue_on_failure is true. Defaults to 'reject'.

continue_on_failure.description: When true and the approval cannot complete for any reason (timeout or send failure after retries), the workflow proceeds using fallback_decision from config. Inherits from global settings when absent.

timeout.description: Activity timeout in seconds. Falls back to the global timeout setting if not specified.

resultSchema.description: Result structure available after approval decision is made

approver.description: User ID or identifier who made the decision (or 'system' for timeout/cancellation)

comments.description: Optional notes provided by approver or system (e.g., 'Auto-rejected due to timeout')
